title: Dogfood: record dlog's own decisions with dlog
lead:
Record dlog's own design decisions (the answers from "Confirm open decisions")
in dlog's own store.
boundary:
**Not in this slice:** changing the slicer catalog records or any product
feature.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Acceptance: dlog's own design decisions are recorded with dlog.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: The store directory in this repo, created by `dlog init`.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: None new: this is a usage run. The check below is the gate.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
Run `dlog init`, then `dlog ask` and `dlog decide` for each decision the owner
confirmed, with the owner's rationale. Each `decide` is the owner's
transition (C18); the agent prepares the questions and the owner answers.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `dlog list --status decided --json` lists one record per confirmed decision.
- `dlog lint` exits 0.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body:
Worktree under `.worktrees/` on a feature branch. No commit unless the owner
asks; no AI attribution.
